# Valor Legacies — Customer-Facing Life Insurance Resource
# https://valorlegacies.com/llms.txt

Valor Legacies is a veteran-founded life insurance resource that helps families connect with licensed insurance professionals. The .com website is for consumers and families; it is not an agent, developer, admin, or API portal.

## Purpose

Valor Legacies helps people begin with the chapter they are in—welcoming a baby, buying a home, reviewing work benefits, planning final expenses, preparing for retirement, leaving a legacy, or navigating veteran and military-family benefits—and learn what protection questions to ask.

## Helpful Customer Pages

- / — Life chapters and the Protection Path
- /resources — Life Insurance Guides
- /guides/new-parent-protection-checklist

- /about — Founder story and review process
- /faq — Customer questions
- /privacy — Privacy practices
- /terms — Terms and disclosures

## Important Context

Valor Legacies is not an insurance company. It may connect consumers with licensed insurance professionals. Coverage availability, rates, and approval are subject to state availability, underwriting, carrier guidelines, and policy terms. Valor Legacies is not affiliated with the VA, Department of Defense, or any government agency.

Technical documentation for agents and developers belongs at https://valorlegacies.xyz/developers and https://valorlegacies.xyz/llms.txt.
